t: Titan TTB1359STM 2200W wallpaper stripper delivers high-performance steam for efficient, chemical-free wallpaper removal. This heavy-duty steam stripper is ideal for professional decorators and demanding home renovation projects. A generous, easy-fill 6.5Ltr tank capacity provides extended steaming time, with up to 120 minutes of continuous steaming from the 18-minute heat-up time. The long 4m hose and 5m cable offer excellent reach across high walls and ceilings. Supplied with large and small steam plates, hose, scraper, and power cord. Equipped with a carry handle.
